svg.text: Smart Safe Guardian — Hardware Wiring Diagram
Vault node (YoloUNO · ESP32-S3), wearable badge (Yolo:Bit · ESP32) and edge gateway. All Grove modules run on 3.3 V logic: no level shifter or pull-up needed.
badge → vault: unlock / lock / ack / pair
Grove cable conductors: red = VCC (3.3 V), black = GND, yellow / white = signal. Servo cable: brown = GND, red = +5 V, orange = signal.
Pin assignments verified against firmware/vault_yolouno and firmware/badge_yolobit sources.
